title: finding(layout,docs): `ResponsiveGrid`'s docblock still says it consumes the spec's retired `BreakpointColumnMapSchema`, and `schema-reference.md` types `GridSchema.columns` as a `Record` over string keys
body:
Filing-gate category: ② published prose that no longer matches the code it describes (a docblock and a reference row), with named sites. Minor: text only. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the round-3 contract review of PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10708 (card objectui#7599, head `cfd9fed6d`, PASS). That review's bundle-wide sweep found these two sites outside the PR's `skills/**` surface and recorded them as follow-ups the PR does not owe. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The two sentences (objectui `origin/main` `93a558555`)

1. `packages/layout/src/ResponsiveGrid.tsx:114-115`, the component docblock:

   > ResponsiveGrid — A layout component that consumes @objectstack/spec
   > BreakpointColumnMapSchema for responsive grid layouts.

   Forty lines above, the same file declares `BreakpointColumnMap` itself (`:53`, the six keys `xs` to `2xl`). Its own comment explains that the spec retired `BreakpointColumnMapSchema` and the name was re-homed in `@object-ui/layout` (objectui#7580, still a pending changeset). The docblock ships in the package's `.d.ts`, so it teaches the retired attribution that objectui#7599 removed from the skills catalog.

2. `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md:227`, the `grid` properties table:

   > `columns` · type `number \| Record` (string keys, number values) · "Number of columns, or responsive map (e.g. `{ sm: 1, md: 2, lg: 3 }`)."

   (The row's generic is written out in words here; the file spells it in TypeScript.)

   On main, `GridSchema.columns` is `number | Partial` of a `Record` over `BreakpointName` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts:769`, objectui#8505's narrowing), and the zod mirror is a `z.partialRecord` over the six names. The row's string-keyed `Record` is the published 17.6.0 shape. It admits any key, so a `cols`-style typo reads as legal.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Rewrite the docblock sentence to name the layout package's own `BreakpointColumnMap`, the same six keys that `grid`'s `BreakpointName` spells.
- Retype the row as `number` or a `Partial` `Record` over `BreakpointName`, naming the six keys. If the row must also serve 17.6.0 readers, add a release qualifier the way objectui#7599's `rules/protocol.md` paragraph does.
- The docblock edit is `packages/layout` source (it ships in `.d.ts`), so it takes a `patch` changeset. The docs row does not.

## Dedupe

objectui issues and PRs, the 300 most recently created, plus the seat's 1069-item snapshot, matched against `BreakpointColumnMapSchema|ResponsiveGrid|schema-reference\.md`:
- No card names either site.
- The `schema-reference.md` hits are other rows: objectui#10581 (`ObjectGridSchema.sort`) and objectui#10662 (`onViewChange`), both closed.
- Lit control: the same walk finds objectui#7599 and PR objectui#10708.
